# Stata to R map {.unnumbered}

Only commands that the scripts in this workflow use are listed.

| Stata or epicalc command | R equivalent | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| `import excel` | `readxl::read_excel()` | 1 |
| `tab sex` (epicalc `tab1`) | `epicalc::tab1()` | 2 |
| `tab treatment sex, row col` | `epicalc::tabpct()` | 2 |
| `table1` style baseline table (epicalc `tableStack`) | `epicalc::tableStack()` | 2 |
| `tabstat fbs, by(group) stat(mean sd n)` | `epicalc::aggregate.numeric()` | 2 |
| `histogram fbs, by(month)` | `ggplot2::geom_histogram()` with `facet_wrap()` | 2 |
| `graph box fbs, over(month)` | `ggplot2::geom_boxplot()` | 2 |
| `twoway scatter fbs dm_duration` | `ggplot2::geom_point()` | 4 |
| `twoway line mean_fbs month` | `ggplot2::geom_line()` | 4 |
| `twoway lowess fbs time` | `ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "loess")` | 4 |
| `twoway lfit fbs time` | `ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm")` | 4 |
| `twoway qfit fbs time` | `ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 2))` | 4 |
| `graph bar (mean) fbs, over(month)` | `ggplot2::geom_col()` | 4 |
| `graph export fig.tif` | `ggplot2::ggsave()` | 4 |
| `spearman var1 var2` | `rstatix::cor_test(method = "spearman")` | 2 |
| `duplicates drop` | `dplyr::distinct()` and `dplyr::slice_head()` | 1 |
| `destring` | `readr::parse_number()` | 1 |
| `gen`, `replace` | `dplyr::mutate()` with `if_else()` and `case_when()` | 1 |
| `keep if`, `drop if` | `dplyr::filter()` | 1 |
| `keep`, `sort` | `dplyr::select()` and `dplyr::arrange()` | 1 |
| `reshape long` | `tidyr::pivot_longer()` | 1 |
| `reshape wide` | `tidyr::pivot_wider()` | 2 |
| `date()` and `mdy()` | `lubridate::dmy()` and `lubridate::ymd()` | 1 |
| `assert` | `stopifnot()` | 1 |
| `save` | `saveRDS()` | 1 |
| `table1_mc` (user written baseline table) | `gtsummary::tbl_summary()` | 3 |
